name: Gedor
title: Descendants of Benjamin and Judah
summary: Gedor is a name that appears in the Bible's genealogies, associated with several individuals from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles, Gedor is mentioned as a son of Penuel in the tribe of Judah, as well as a son of Jehiel from the tribe of Benjamin. The name is also linked to a town in the region of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Gedor is mentioned as a son of Penuel in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Gedor in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Another Gedor is mentioned as a son of Jehiel, the ancestor of Gibeon, in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Gedor as a geographical location
keyEvents.description: Gedor is also mentioned as a place in the hill country of Judah, associated with the territory of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Entry of the Simeonites into Gedor
keyEvents.description: The Simeonites went to Gedor to seek grazing lands and destroyed the original inhabitants there during the time of King Hezekiah.
